minor.issue: CATALOG_CACHE.clear() runs every 60s cycle even when no file changed; and if a whole chapter JSON file is deleted, its cards are never retired (retire query only runs per existing file).

issues: Subject-tinted small text (11-12px) on black is below 4.5:1: Biology #1F7A55 ~4.0:1, Chemistry #8A6A22 ~4.2:1, Physics #D7263D ~4.2:1 (rapid/session.tsx:213, :55). Consider a lighter text variant of subject colours for text use.
Recent chips are not filtered by exam: in NEET a Maths recent chip would appear and tapping it silently flips exam to JEE (rapid.tsx:240). Consider filtering recent to current exam subjects.
